unit.why: A single narrative, transmitted from the author's father, about R. Alexander of Sambor: the Seer of Lublin promises him a son with a great soul, and the son's birth and circumcision are followed by a blessing from a disciple of the Besht.

stories.start_quote: ושמעתי מפי אאמו״ר זללה״ה שאביו הוא
stories.end_quote: הדיבורים של הצדיק הזה ושמח עוד יותר
stories.summary_en: R. Alexander, childless of a son after forty, is promised by the Seer of Lublin a son with an exceptionally great soul, at the price of his own death when the boy turns ten; the boy's birth fills the house with light, and at the circumcision feast a disciple of the Besht blesses the child, frightening the mother and then reassuring her of his long life.
